author: Pallas, 1811
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 국내에는 매우 드물게 찾아오는 겨울새로, 주로 먼바다에서 지내 해안에서는 보기 어렵다. 혼자 지내거나 10~15마리가 작은 무리를 이룬다. 번식기는 4~6월이며 고산 지대의 땅 위에 알을 1개 낳는다. 동해안 일대의 정치망 어업과 기름 유출로 인한 해양 오염 같은 외부 위협이 많다.

points.en: underparts heavily mottled brown and white (breeding)

art.subject: Long-billed Murrelet (Brachyramphus perdix), adult in winter plumage, as seen far off the Korean east coast in winter: crown, nape and hindneck dark grey-brown, the dark cap reaching just below the eye; a narrow white eye-ring; throat, foreneck and sides of the neck white; back and wings dark grey with faint paler fringes; a conspicuous white patch along the scapulars on each side of the back; breast, belly and flanks white. Bill black, slender and sharply pointed; dark eye.
art.pose: swimming alone on the open sea, side view
art.scene: open sea far off the Korean east coast in winter, grey swell; no people, buildings or text
views: adult non-breeding (winter), side view swimming: dark grey-brown crown and nape, dark grey back, narrow white eye-ring, conspicuous white scapular patch, white throat, neck sides and underparts, slender pointed black bill a little shorter than the head
adult breeding (spring and summer), side view swimming: dark brown upperparts finely speckled buff, pale throat, underparts heavily mottled dark brown and white, long slender black bill
art.build: Small, compact, short-tailed auk, 25cm, about the size of a Little Grebe, with a rounded head and short neck; no crest, the crown feathers lie flat. Bill black, slender and sharply pointed, a little shorter than the head but noticeably longer and finer than in other small murrelets. Swims low and buoyantly and dives frequently. Wings narrow and pointed; flight fast and low with whirring wingbeats, showing dark underwings.
avoid: Do not paint the white face stripes, black throat and grey back of Ancient Murrelet (Synthliboramphus antiquus).
Do not paint a short stubby bill; the bill is long and slender for a murrelet.
Do not make it murre-sized; it is a small, compact seabird.
Do not omit the white scapular stripe on winter birds.
